title: Metropolis acceptance probability
caption: A move that lowers the energy is always accepted; one that raises it by ΔE is accepted with probability e^{−ΔE/k_BT}. For the lesson's spin flip, ΔE = 2J at k_BT = J, so ΔE/k_BT = 2 and the probability is e^{−2} = 0.135, about 14%.
alt: Graph of acceptance probability against energy increase over k_B T: flat at 1 for negative values, then an exponential decay through 0.135 at 2.
description: The horizontal axis is ΔE/k_BT; the vertical axis is the acceptance probability.
For ΔE ≤ 0 the move is always accepted (probability 1).
For ΔE > 0 the probability is e^{−ΔE/k_BT}; at ΔE/k_BT = 2 it is 0.135.

checks.name: ΔE = 0 is accepted with probability 1 (continuous at 0)
